decision: Clone the referenced Atelier staging files into a Kit-owned home before the re-gate; leave the Hugging Face checkpoint and adapter blobs in the user's Hugging Face cache (Atelier OK'd the read-only clone).
home: ~/.cache/aether-kit/h3/profile-c49d8dbf/ (bundle.json, h3-fl2va/ clone, models/ overlay, build-overlay.json, clone-manifest.json)
pathOnly: The new bundle.json is the old one with two path prefixes rewritten (1,240 staging paths, including lineage.base_bundle, and 4 overlay model paths); mapping the new prefixes back reproduces the old bytes exactly. Every content hash is unchanged. Kit requires absolute profile paths and identifies a profile by its manifest bytes, so the identity changes.

clone.method: clonefile(2) per file (Python ctypes), largest first, failing on any nonzero return; abort if Data free space fell by more than 2 GiB
clone.overlay: the four tiled first-frame encoder models (0.67 GiB) copied from Scratch (another volume)

verification.rule: every path+sha256 entry under the new home: whole-file SHA-256, or main.mlirb for .aimodel packages, plus the lineage base bundle

dumps: T2VA and FL2VA 960x544x120 dumps regenerated under the new identity: every field except profile_sha256 and every tensor hash equal the gate dumps
measuredAdmission: The bundled entry is keyed by the c49d8dbf identity until the re-gate measures 5af39db5.
followUp: Allow profile paths relative to bundle.json (H3 promotion backlog), so a profile's identity no longer depends on where it is stored.
